howTo.name: How to Set a Bedtime Lock Screen with SleepBuddy

steps.name: Download SleepBuddy
steps.text: Download SleepBuddy from the App Store (apps.apple.com/app/id6773677490).

steps.name: Create your free account
steps.text: Open the app and create your free account.

steps.name: Set your bedtime and wake time
steps.text: Set your bedtime (for example, 10:30 PM) and your wake time.

steps.name: Enable the Bedtime Lock Screen
steps.text: Enable the Bedtime Lock Screen so SleepBuddy automatically locks your phone at your set bedtime.

steps.name: Pair with a friend
steps.text: Optionally pair with a friend for social accountability; you'll both see whether you stuck to bedtime.

steps.name: Review your progress
steps.text: Each morning, open SleepBuddy to review your progress and adjust your schedule.
